# ui::TwoWayField

Header: `winui/core/Property.hpp`.

```cpp
template <typename T> class TwoWayField
```

Derives from `ui::Binding< T >`.

The type of an editable spec field: one the user changes and a two-way [bind()](namespace-ui.md#bind) writes back from (a text box's `text`, a slider's `value`, a `selected_index`, an `is_open`). It is a Binding<T> in every way but two, both refusing a two-way [bind()](namespace-ui.md#bind) of a property that cannot hold what the control writes back, where a plain [Binding](binding.md) would silently go one-way:

- A writable [`Property<U>`](property.md) whose type loses some of the field's values does not compile: `.value = level` with a [`Property<int> level`](property.md) on a [Slider](../controls/slider.md#uislider), whose value is a double. Bind a property of the field's own type, or say one-way with [bind_one_way()](namespace-ui.md#bind_one_way). Types that convert both ways without loss stay two-way (a [`Property<float>`](property.md) on that same [Slider](../controls/slider.md#uislider)).
- A field that can be unset (a selection that can be empty, a check box's indeterminate state, an empty number box) is a `TwoWayField<std::optional<T>>`, and a two-way [bind()](namespace-ui.md#bind) of a [`Property<T>`](property.md) into it does not compile: the control can go unset, which the property cannot hold. Bind a [`Property<std::optional<T>>`](property.md), or [bind_one_way()](namespace-ui.md#bind_one_way).

A display field stays a plain [Binding](binding.md), and [bind()](namespace-ui.md#bind) of any property that converts goes into it one-way.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::optional<std::size_t>> picked;
ui::Property<std::size_t>                size{0};
ui::Property<int>                        volume{40};
ui::ComboBox{.items = {"Small", "Large"}, .selected_index = picked};       // two-way
ui::ComboBox{.items = {"Small", "Large"}, .selected_index = ui::bind_one_way(size)}; // one-way
ui::Slider{.value = ui::bind_one_way(volume)};                             // one-way
// .selected_index = size does not compile: the dropdown can be left with
// nothing selected, which `size` cannot hold.
// .value = volume does not compile: a drag to 40.5 does not fit an int.
```

## TwoWayField

```cpp
TwoWayField() = default
```

A constant value-initialized T.

## TwoWayField

```cpp
TwoWayField(Binding<T> binding)
```

Any binding of the field's own type: a constant, [bind()](namespace-ui.md#bind) or [bind_one_way()](namespace-ui.md#bind_one_way).

## TwoWayField

```cpp
TwoWayField(ChoiceBinding choice)
    requires std::same_as<T, std::size_t>
```

[bind_choice()](namespace-ui.md#bind_choice) into an index field that always shows a selection. A value not in the list leaves the selection where it is, and starts the field on the first choice.

## TwoWayField

```cpp
template <typename U>
TwoWayField(const TwoWayBinding<U>& two_way)
    requires detail::LossyWriteBack<U, T> && (!detail::UnsetIntoPlain<U, T>)
```

Does not compile: a two-way [bind()](namespace-ui.md#bind) of a [`Property<U>`](property.md) that cannot hold every value of the field. See the class comment.

## TwoWayField

```cpp
template <typename S>
TwoWayField(S& source)
    requires detail::is_source<S> && (!std::is_const_v<S>) && std::same_as<S, Property<detail::source_value_t<S>>> && detail::LossyWriteBack<detail::source_value_t<S>, T> && (!detail::UnsetIntoPlain<detail::source_value_t<S>, T>)
```

Does not compile: a writable [`Property<U>`](property.md) written straight into the field, the same two-way [bind()](namespace-ui.md#bind) as above. See the class comment.

## TwoWayField

```cpp
template <typename U>
TwoWayField(const TwoWayBinding<U>& two_way) = delete
    requires detail::OptionalValue<T>::optional && (!detail::OptionalValue<U>::optional)
```

Deleted: a two-way [bind()](namespace-ui.md#bind) of a [`Property<U>`](property.md) into a field that can be unset. See the class comment.

## TwoWayField

```cpp
template <typename S>
TwoWayField(S& source) = delete
    requires detail::is_source<S> && detail::PropertyBindsTo<detail::source_value_t<S>, T> && (!std::is_const_v<S>) && std::same_as<S, Property<detail::source_value_t<S>>> && detail::OptionalValue<T>::optional && (!detail::OptionalValue<detail::source_value_t<S>>::optional)
```

Deleted: a writable [`Property<U>`](property.md) written straight into a field that can be unset, which is the same two-way [bind()](namespace-ui.md#bind) as above. See the class comment.
